headline: Meta bets on AI agent Muse to catch up in AI race
summary: Meta is launching 'Muse,' a new personal AI assistant. This is part of a multi-billion dollar strategy to boost its AI position. Muse aims to make AI accessible to the masses.

headline: Anthropic faces class action lawsuit over misleading power users.
summary: Anthropic is being sued by power users claiming they were misled about subscription benefits. The lawsuit alleges the company failed to deliver promised value to top-tier customers. This legal action questions Anthropic's transparency regarding its service offerings.

headline: Nintendo isn’t scared of GTA VI
summary: Most game companies are wary of competing with Grand Theft Auto VI's launch. Nintendo, however, remains unfazed by the upcoming blockbuster. The company focused a recent showcase entirely on its Legend of Zelda series.

headline: Tesla Cybercab features a secret virtual joystick for manual control.
summary: The Tesla Cybercab was launched without visible manual controls like a steering wheel. Riders have now discovered a hidden virtual joystick for manual operation. This revelation challenges the initial perception of the autonomous vehicle.

headline: Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition Switch 2 preorders announced.
summary: Preorders are opening for the Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition Nintendo Switch 2. Accompanying accessories, including a Pro Controller and carrying case, will also be available. All items are set to release on October 29th.

headline: Marvel’s Wolverine PS5 game to feature multiple comic book costumes.
summary: The upcoming Marvel's Wolverine PS5 game will include various iconic comic book costumes. Insomniac's new title draws heavily from decades of X-Men lore. This article breaks down all confirmed outfits for the game.

headline: Shift Up CTO clarifies Stellar Blade's AI stance after controversy.
summary: Shift Up's CTO addressed concerns regarding the use of AI in their work. This clarification follows backlash over the 'Blood Rain' music video for Stellar Blade. The statement aims to explain the developer's position on AI integration.

headline: Deal: Talix 20,000mAh 140W Power Bank now 57% off.
summary: The TSA-approved Talix 20,000mAh 140W Power Bank is currently discounted by 57%. Now available for just $39, including shipping. It's capable of fast charging high-power devices like gaming PCs and MacBook Pros.

headline: UK sanctions West Bank settlements, sparking furious Israeli response.
summary: Britain's foreign secretary announced sanctions against West Bank settlements. The UK official accused settlers of 'ethnic cleansing' of Palestinians. Israel retaliated by closing the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

headline: Ports deny requests to land 120 migrants via RNLI boats.
summary: Both the King's Harbour Master and Southampton Port rejected requests on Sunday. They refused to allow 120 migrants to disembark from RNLI boats. The decision prevents migrants from landing at these UK ports.

headline: Trump shares misleading video of King Charles and fainted worker.
summary: Donald Trump shared a video seemingly showing King Charles ignoring a fainting man. The footage appears to be misleading or taken out of context. The clip depicts the King shrugging and walking away during a royal visit.

headline: Glastonbury confirms ticket sale dates and record-high prices.
summary: Glastonbury Festival has announced its ticket sale dates. This year's tickets have surpassed £400 for the first time ever. The festival is set to return in June after a 'fallow' year.
